acceptanceCriteria.text: Every plugin REPL launcher passes --agent, including the default agent value.
Verified marker cache entries are keyed by canonical agent identity and workspace.
Named-agent child process invocation is covered by integration tests.

The REPL verified-marker cache uses QBRAINAI_REPL_CACHE_DIR when set, otherwise MCP_REPL_CACHE_DIR, through ProductEnvironment alias precedence; when neither is set it uses the user-profile cache. A child process can therefore isolate all verified-marker cache reads and writes in its owned root. The path selection is proved by unit tests over explicit settings and profile values. Operator 2026-10-30: Product env override (Recommended), RINT-10.

result.description: Agent REPL callers must identify the invoking agent on every qbrain-ai-repl invocation so session, cache, and verified marker state are isolated per agent and workspace.
result.title: Per-agent REPL isolation
